allow: Bash(sqlite3 -header -column "file:metrics.sqlite?mode=ro" "SELECT axis, COUNT\(DISTINCT metric_name\) AS n_metrics, COUNT\(*\) AS n_rows, MIN\(step\) AS min_step, MAX\(step\) AS max_step FROM metric_events GROUP BY axis;")

Bash(sqlite3 -header -column "file:metrics.sqlite?mode=ro" "WITH tail AS \(SELECT metric_name, value FROM metric_events WHERE run_name='ProfiledSpawns1_p1_adaptive_20260526-175136' AND axis='episode' AND step > \(SELECT MAX\(step\) FROM metric_events WHERE axis='episode'\) - 100 AND metric_name IN \('Outcome/Success','Outcome/Crash','Outcome/Offroad','Outcome/Stuck','Outcome/Timeout','Safety/Shield_Rate','Reward/Raw_Episode','CARLA/Mean_Speed_kmh','CARLA/Total_Distance','CARLA/Low_Speed_Fraction','Outcome/Parked_Fraction','Training/Episode_Length'\)\) SELECT metric_name, ROUND\(AVG\(value\),3\) AS mean, COUNT\(*\) n FROM tail GROUP BY metric_name ORDER BY metric_name;")

Bash(sqlite3 -header -column "file:metrics.sqlite?mode=ro" "WITH outc AS \(SELECT step AS episode, CAST\(value AS INTEGER\) AS outcome_type FROM metric_events WHERE axis='episode' AND metric_name='Outcome/Type'\) SELECT \(\(episode-1\)/100\)*100+1 AS block_start, SUM\(outcome_type=4\) AS success, SUM\(outcome_type=1\) AS crash, SUM\(outcome_type=3\) AS offroad, SUM\(outcome_type=2\) AS stuck, SUM\(outcome_type=0\) AS timeout, COUNT\(*\) AS total FROM outc GROUP BY block_start ORDER BY block_start;")

Bash(sqlite3 -header -column "file:metrics.sqlite?mode=ro" "SELECT step AS ts, ROUND\(MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Loss/Policy_Loss' THEN value END\),5\) AS policy, ROUND\(MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Loss/Value_Loss' THEN value END\),4\) AS value, ROUND\(MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Loss/Grad_Norm' THEN value END\),3\) AS gn, ROUND\(MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Training/Entropy' THEN value END\),3\) AS ent, ROUND\(MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Training/Approx_KL' THEN value END\),4\) AS kl, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Training/Epochs_Run' THEN value END\) AS epR, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Training/Epochs_Rejected' THEN value END\) AS epRJ, ROUND\(MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Training/Shielded_Fraction' THEN value END\),3\) AS sFrac, ROUND\(MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Training/Log_Std_Steering_Raw' THEN value END\),3\) AS stR, ROUND\(MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Training/Log_Std_Throttle_Raw' THEN value END\),3\) AS thR, ROUND\(MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Training/Log_Std_Saturated_Fraction' THEN value END\),2\) AS sat, ROUND\(MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Training/Entropy_Coef_Current' THEN value END\),5\) AS eCoef, ROUND\(MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Training/Learning_Rate' THEN value END\),6\) AS lr FROM metric_events WHERE axis='update' GROUP BY step ORDER BY step;")

Bash(sqlite3 -header -column "file:metrics.sqlite?mode=ro" "SELECT \(\(step-1\)/100\)*100+1 AS block, ROUND\(AVG\(MAX_C\),2\) AS reward, ROUND\(AVG\(SPEED\),2\) AS speed, ROUND\(AVG\(DIST\),2\) AS distance, ROUND\(AVG\(LEN\),1\) AS len, ROUND\(AVG\(SR\),3\) AS shield_rate, ROUND\(AVG\(MSA\),3\) AS mean_alpha, ROUND\(AVG\(LOW\),3\) AS low_speed, ROUND\(AVG\(PRK\),3\) AS parked, ROUND\(AVG\(SOL\),2\) AS solid_inv FROM \(SELECT step, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Reward/Raw_Episode' THEN value END\) MAX_C, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='CARLA/Mean_Speed_kmh' THEN value END\) SPEED, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='CARLA/Total_Distance' THEN value END\) DIST, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Training/Episode_Length' THEN value END\) LEN, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Safety/Shield_Rate' THEN value END\) SR, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Reward/Components/Shield_Intensity_Mean' THEN value END\) MSA, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='CARLA/Low_Speed_Fraction' THEN value END\) LOW, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Outcome/Parked_Fraction' THEN value END\) PRK, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Reward/Components/Solid_Invasion_Events' THEN value END\) SOL FROM metric_events WHERE axis='episode' GROUP BY step\) GROUP BY block ORDER BY block;")

Bash(sqlite3 -header -column "file:metrics.sqlite?mode=ro" "SELECT \(\(step-1\)/100\)*100+1 AS block, ROUND\(AVG\(ALIVE\),2\) AS alive, ROUND\(AVG\(SPB\),2\) AS speedB, ROUND\(AVG\(CENT\),3\) AS center, ROUND\(AVG\(HEAD\),3\) AS heading, ROUND\(AVG\(SMTH\),3\) AS smooth, ROUND\(AVG\(INV\),3\) AS invasion, ROUND\(AVG\(ROAD\),3\) AS roadPen, ROUND\(AVG\(PROG\),2\) AS progress, ROUND\(AVG\(IDLE\),3\) AS idle, ROUND\(AVG\(DRIFT\),3\) AS drift, ROUND\(AVG\(SOL\),3\) AS solid, ROUND\(AVG\(WH\),3\) AS wrongH FROM \(SELECT step, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Reward/Components/Alive_Bonus' THEN value END\) ALIVE, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Reward/Components/Speed_Bonus' THEN value END\) SPB, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Reward/Components/Lane_Centering' THEN value END\) CENT, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Reward/Components/Heading_Alignment' THEN value END\) HEAD, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Reward/Components/Smooth_Penalty' THEN value END\) SMTH, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Reward/Components/Invasion_Penalty' THEN value END\) INV, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Reward/Components/Road_Penalty' THEN value END\) ROAD, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Reward/Components/Progress_Bonus' THEN value END\) PROG, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Reward/Components/Idle_Penalty' THEN value END\) IDLE, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Reward/Components/Drift_Penalty' THEN value END\) DRIFT, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Reward/Components/Solid_Invasion_Pen' THEN value END\) SOL, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Reward/Components/Wrong_Heading_Pen' THEN value END\) WH FROM metric_events WHERE axis='episode' GROUP BY step\) GROUP BY block ORDER BY block;")

Bash(sqlite3 -header -column "file:metrics.sqlite?mode=ro" "SELECT \(\(step-1\)/100\)*100+1 AS block, ROUND\(AVG\(LAT\),3\) AS lat_off, ROUND\(AVG\(HEAD\),3\) AS heading_deg, ROUND\(AVG\(STEER\),3\) AS abs_steer, ROUND\(AVG\(LANE_INV\),2\) AS lane_inv, ROUND\(AVG\(SAFE\),3\) AS safe, ROUND\(AVG\(WARN\),3\) AS warn, ROUND\(AVG\(CRIT\),3\) AS crit, ROUND\(AVG\(DYN\),2\) AS dyn_intv, ROUND\(AVG\(STAT\),2\) AS stat_intv, ROUND\(AVG\(H1\),2\) AS H1, ROUND\(AVG\(H5\),2\) AS H5, ROUND\(AVG\(H10\),2\) AS H10 FROM \(SELECT step, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='CARLA/Mean_Lateral_Offset_Norm' THEN value END\) LAT, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='CARLA/Mean_Heading_Error_deg' THEN value END\) HEAD, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='CARLA/Mean_Abs_Steering' THEN value END\) STEER, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='CARLA/Lane_Invasions_Ep' THEN value END\) LANE_INV, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Safety/Semantic/Safe_Step_Rate' THEN value END\) SAFE, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Safety/Semantic/Warning_Step_Rate' THEN value END\) WARN, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Safety/Semantic/Critical_Step_Rate' THEN value END\) CRIT, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Safety/Semantic/Dynamic_Interventions' THEN value END\) DYN, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Safety/Semantic/Static_Interventions' THEN value END\) STAT, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Safety/Horizon/H1_Activations' THEN value END\) H1, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Safety/Horizon/H5_Activations' THEN value END\) H5, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Safety/Horizon/H10_Activations' THEN value END\) H10 FROM metric_events WHERE axis='episode' GROUP BY step\) GROUP BY block ORDER BY block;")

Bash(sqlite3 -header -column "file:metrics.sqlite?mode=ro" "SELECT DISTINCT value AS npc, COUNT\(*\) FROM metric_events WHERE axis='episode' AND metric_name='Training/Curriculum_NPC' GROUP BY value;")

Bash(sqlite3 -header -column "file:metrics.sqlite?mode=ro" "WITH ep AS \(SELECT step, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='Outcome/Type' THEN value END\) outc, MAX\(CASE WHEN metric_name='CARLA/Total_Distance' THEN value END\) dist FROM metric_events WHERE axis='episode' GROUP BY step\) SELECT CAST\(outc AS INTEGER\) AS outcome, COUNT\(*\) n, ROUND\(AVG\(dist\),1\) AS mean_dist, ROUND\(MIN\(dist\),1\) AS min_dist, ROUND\(MAX\(dist\),1\) AS max_dist FROM ep GROUP BY outc ORDER BY outc;")
